Open Pixel2Play (P2P) Full Dataset
	

Paper | GitHub | Project Page | Toy Dataset

The p2p-full-data dataset contains 8300+ hours of high-quality human annotated data, spanning across more than 40 popular 3D video games. All gameplay is recorded at 20 FPS by experienced players. Each frame is annotated with keyboard and mouse actions, and text instructions are provided when available.
If you found the dataset helpful, please consider upvoting the paper so it can reach more people!… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/elefantai/p2p-full-data.
